{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Museum Artifact Recovery Office''' was a department of the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In the wake of the [[Imperial Civil War]], the department was willing to fund a covert expedition to [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]] to investigate claims that the [[Emperor's Shadow (shuttle)|''Emperor's Shadow'']], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] rumored to be equipped with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], had crash-landed in one of the oceans.<ref name="FFCA">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
